radius-xs.$description: Smallest corner radius — tiny inset elements (checkbox box, kbd key, table/sidebar hover buttons, legend swatch, inline code, audit-log diff chips, small tags). The bottom rung below radius-sm.

radius-xl.$description: Largest corner radius below pill: hero cards, sheets, large dialogs (HAR-1384, shipped with HAR-1562).

radius-inner.$description: Concentric corners: the corner of a surface nested inside a rounded container, so the two curves stay parallel (outer radius minus the gap between them, never below 0). The container names its corner in --uix-radius-outer and the gap from its outer edge to the nested surface (its border plus padding) in --uix-radius-inset; the nested surface sets border-radius: var(--uix-radius-inner). A pill stays a pill (999px less a few px). --uix-radius-inner-min is an optional floor for a surface whose inset is as large as the corner. The three inputs are write-only slots like --uix-brand, so with no --uix-radius-outer above it the value is invalid and var(--uix-radius-inner, <fallback>) takes the fallback. Resolved on every element (the per-element rule in tokens.css), because a custom property resolved on :root would inherit as one fixed length.

row-h-standard.$description: The standard row height, held by a table that asks for it (Table density="standard", HAR-2631): a page-wide re-point of --uix-row-h (a density or spacing preference) does not reach it. A table that names no density follows --uix-row-h.

sidebar-w-rail.$description: Collapsed icon-rail width for the app-shell sidebar (data-nav=rail / data-collapsed). Contractual so the rail width stops being hand-coded as 56px in app-shell.css and products can retheme it. Full = --uix-sidebar-w, rail = this, hidden = 0.

col-w-xs.$description: Table column-width scale — the shared tier set consumers attach to a column via .uix-col--w-* (on <col>/<th>/<td>) instead of hand-coding per-app pixel widths. Reconciles the widths house products use for compact data columns: xs≈priority/flag, sm≈type/date, md≈id/status/team, lg≈assignee/person, lg-plus≈a status pill with long German state words, xl≈long labels. Snap each column to the nearest tier.

col-w-lg-plus.$description: HAR-3099: between lg and xl — 176 px of content after the cell's 16 + 16 px padding, so a md StatusPill of about 165 px ("Wartet auf Zustimmung") stays on one line without a 240 px column.

col-title-min.$description: Min-width floor for the primary/flex column (.uix-col--flex) — the subject/title never collapses below this; the table scrolls horizontally (pinned first column intact) instead of squeezing the title. Generalises the old 280px title cap.
